title: Split code_tutor/_challenge.py under the 250-line cap
objective: Bring python_pkg/code_tutor/_challenge.py (467 lines) under the repo-wide 250-line cap by moving the two challenge flows and the public entry point into _challenge_flows.py, and the static prompt strings into _challenge_prompts.py.
acceptance_criteria: _challenge.py, _challenge_flows.py and _challenge_prompts.py are each at most 250 lines.
The code_tutor suite still reports exactly 216 passing tests -- the same count as before the split, proving no test was dropped or silently skipped.
The package keeps 100% branch coverage of the code_tutor source modules.

Every patch string in test_challenge_part3.py names the module its function-under-test now resolves collaborators through, decided per test rather than by a blanket substitution: the _run_user_impl tests keep _challenge, the flow and entry-point tests move to _challenge_flows.
The suite completes in seconds. A patch that no longer intercepts here does not fail - it lets the real interactive flow run and the suite spins, so wall-clock time is part of the pass condition.
No assertion is changed and no test is deleted, skipped or weakened.
No suppression is added and no coverage exclusion is introduced.
out_of_scope: Changing what any test asserts, or any prompt text.
Splitting cli.py, _analyzer.py, _verifier.py, _llm.py or the code_tutor test modules, which are separate commits.
Adding a re-export shim in _challenge; _verifier.py points at _challenge_flows directly.
verifier: timeout 90 env PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m pytest python_pkg/code_tutor/tests -q (expects exactly 216 passed, well inside the timeout), plus an import-time assertion that every patched name resolves on the module its test names, plus pre-commit run --files on the touched files.
